title: Object parameters in property checks (H2's rest): the object properties have the own checker's verdicts under JBMC and auto --confirm
description: jvmcontract prove now takes static methods with parameters of application classes, each made in the harness by its constructor from symbolic primitive leaves (step H2 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md); --nullable and --may-alias on such a parameter are boolean inputs of the harness's own, so JBMC is given the same harness. The property reads field paths (l.price.cents, \old(l.quantity)) and compares references (result == l, from == to). lib/tests/heap.rs checks eight such properties on the own checker inline (bump, withQuantity, size under --nullable l, move under --may-alias from,to; a correct version verified and a defective one refuted, each witness run on a JVM). This job runs its ignored test, which runs the same eight under --engine jbmc and under --engine auto --confirm (JBMC proving again what the own checker proved).
expected: exits 0: the ignored test passes. Under both, the four after-build properties are Verified and the four defect-build ones Violation, each violation's witness confirmed on a JVM (replay by jvm, reproduced).

resources.notes: a release build of the crate, then 16 small JBMC runs (harnesses of a few dozen instructions, no loops)

steps.name: object properties under JBMC and auto --confirm
